contracts.producer: Orchestrator backend config validator / reject unknown subagent
contracts.predicate: validation -> refused before child dispatch; invalid_names must be nonempty; do not save an invalid configuration
message absent -> posted; from_agent_id is an admitted member of this crew; explicit targets stay in this crew; commit attributable AgentMessage before publishing
posted -> read_by includes agent_id; require retained message and current member access; repeated same receipt is idempotent
visible -> archived only after 24 hours; unresolved blockers remain visible until resolved; exact message_ids required, no deletion on archive

contracts.producer: Provider output parser / record parse failure
contracts.predicate: parse attempt -> fallback pending; first log this failure, then generic extraction, then at most one same-Provider retry; recording or reading never retries
active phase -> force completed only when configured maximum is finite and question_count > max_questions + 1 without completion signal; preserve all collected answers
running -> running; budget_used_pct and budget_limit are observations, never budget increases
queued|running|awaiting_parent|blocked -> cancelled; settle actual child cancellation before terminal publication
running -> complete; require committed result and usage references before terminal publication
running -> running; record measured context_usage_pct and threshold; warning grants no context mutation
running|awaiting_parent|blocked -> same state; target is the actual parent, no widened authority
running -> failed; preserve failure cause; no success publication
running|awaiting_parent|blocked -> same state; preserve turn_index and response identity
running|awaiting_parent|blocked -> same state; preserve turn_index and message identity; no hidden peer channel

contracts.producer: Child runtime resolver / apply model switch
contracts.predicate: running -> running; from_model equals prior effective model and to_model equals newly admitted effective model
running -> running; original_length >= truncated_length; full source custody is preserved
running -> awaiting_parent or blocked according to the canonical pause cause; require the actual run-owned pause checkpoint; paused is an operation description, not a new child state
running -> running; progress is advisory and never completion evidence
awaiting_parent|blocked -> running; same child, fresh permission and stop-epoch validation, never reopen a terminal child

contracts.producer: Child retry owner / create next attempt
contracts.predicate: failed -> queued in the same child lineage with strictly increasing attempt_number; never resume or replace a child implicitly
absent -> queued; allocate child identity once after parent permission and capacity admission
queued -> running; parent and child execution admission must still be current
running -> failed with timeout reason; elapsed deadline is not proof that a provider process has stopped
running -> running; one admitted tool invocation, preserve invocation identity
running -> running; require the same prior invocation_id and actual result; success=false remains a result
